name: Lisa Londergan
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Austin, Texas
education: St. Mary's University School of Law
about: A partner at Thompson Salinas Londergan LLP, Lisa Londergan focuses her practice exclusively on family law matters. From the firm's offices in Austin, Texas, she provides representation to people throughout the surrounding areas. Fluent in both English and Spanish, Ms. Londergan has been admitted to practice in Texas since 2004.

A significant portion of Ms. Londergan's practice is centered on divorce and its related issues such as property division, child custody and visitation, and spousal and child support. Many of her clients are prominent business owners, and she helps them come to an accord on the valuation of complex assets such as business interests, retirement accounts, and stock options. A forceful courtroom advocate in cases where litigation is necessary, Ms. Londergan's extensive experience in mediation, negotiations and collaborative law can be useful in helping her clients reach an agreement through these alternative dispute resolution methods. In addition to her divorce practice, she assists people whose marriages have already been dissolved and who are now attempting to obtain a modification to or the enforcement of existing parenting and support orders. Ms. Londergan has also prepared and reviewed prenuptial agreements, and her family law background includes paternity establishment and disputes as well.

Ms. Londergan's handling of what are often sensitive and contentious matters has earned her the recognition of her fellow attorneys, including an AV Preeminent* peer review rating through Martindale-Hubbell and a 10.0 "Superb" peer review rating through Avvo. In addition, she has been named to The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 under 40, and she has been selected for inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America. A 2004 recipient of a Juris Doctor from St. Mary’s University School of Law, Ms. Londergan is a member of several professional organizations, including the Capital Area Trial Lawyers Association.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
